pd_earnest_6.summary: Jack embraces Algernon as his brother and introduces him to everyone
Gwendolen demands to know Jack's real Christian name
Jack questions Lady Bracknell and Algernon about his father's name
Jack tears through the Army Lists and finds the name Ernest John
Jack calmly announces his name is Ernest and Gwendolen forgives him
Three couples embrace, crying at last
Jack answers Lady Bracknell with the importance of being earnest

s01116.summary: Izabella pours for her ex Teddy as everyone watches him taste
Camila exposes Teddy's tepid verdict as code for sour
Henrik praises the wine and Izabella introduces him as her fiance
Teddy congratulates stiffly, drains his glass, and Camila offers another

s01105.summary: Fionnuala scopes enemies from a ruined cinema roof beside wounded Ikenna
Tavakoli's noise makes Fionnuala flinch and Ikenna calms her
The projectionist reveals which roof beams do not creak
Ikenna crawls toward the beams, leaving a trail of blood
Fionnuala orders Tavakoli to follow and says she will stay
A shell whistles in, and Tavakoli crawls after Ikenna's signal
Fionnuala rises and takes aim as fire flickers in the screen

s01103.summary: Cordelia and Artemus wade through the flooded asylum cellar
Artemus's flash reveals a figure standing against the far wall
Artemus wants to leave; Cordelia explains they seek patient Mary Hargreave
A woman's voice hums a lullaby and Cordelia warns not to answer
A pale face rises in the water and they both look away
A hand seizes Cordelia's ankle, she screams, the lantern falls
A flash shows a woman in a nightgown gripping Cordelia, then black

s01114.summary: Anselmo sits in the stairwell ignoring urgent pages
Anselmo lists his crushing workload and recalls an attending's words
He puts his hat back on, answers the page, and climbs

s00010.summary: Armed Dez watches Oksana at the dials, warning her off the brake
Oksana reminds Dez that eleven people, including kids, are stranded
At gunpoint, Oksana lies to Base that everything is fine
Dez levels the pistol and makes Oksana send Marguerite home
Dez calculates they have fifteen minutes before the sheriff
Forced to open the duffel, Oksana finds a steel case with a wrist strap
Ski patroller Tariq walks in and sees the gun
Dez seats Tariq and rips away his radio
As headlights approach, Oksana tells Base about the gunman
Marguerite tells her to move the car into the sheriff's hands
Oksana offers Dez a way out; he kicks the case at her
Dez cocks the pistol and Oksana pulls the lever

pd_earnest_5.summary: The men vow to face christening and the couples embrace
Merriman announces Lady Bracknell and the couples spring apart
Lady Bracknell forbids Gwendolen's engagement to Jack outright
Algernon flusters through Bunbury's sudden explosive death
Algernon and Cecily announce their engagement
Lady Bracknell probes Cecily's origins and Jack coldly lists addresses

s01109.summary: Billie tests the old scoreboard and blares the horn by mistake
The janitor warns of lights out and Billie asks for five minutes
Billie spotlights center court and gazes at the empty circle
Billie stages a phantom game, running the score up to 99
She sounds a final horn, whispers good game, and goes dark

s01035.summary: Renata reports three calm souls in the quarantined gift shop
Adebayo and Miles joke about snow globes and placebos
Adebayo coughs and Miles presses him on how long
Renata orders everyone still and blames Miles for missing symptoms
Searchlights from a foreign hull sweep the promenade
Renata radios the bridge and Hale whispers not to open the door

s00001.summary: Detective Odalys enters a rain-swept taxidermy workshop and is offered tea
Odalys probes the woman about the museum break-in
Ingrid turns, and a museum key tag sits on her shelf
Odalys reaches for her belt and orders Ingrid to drop the needle

s01077.summary: Orozco spots a dust cloud on the east road
Voss sees Orozco's fear and tells him to breathe
Voss looks and reports both armor and trucks approaching
Voss rejects hiding in the engine and readies a signal mirror
She flashes the ridge; no answer, but she will signal anyway
As the dust swells, Voss gently stops Orozco's rifle
Engines rise while she keeps flashing and he counts

s01088.summary: Bee and Bram drag the unconscious captain across the mudflat
Bee checks the captain's pulse as Bram warns the tide is turning
Bee forces Bram to choose between the water and the captain
They lift the stretcher but Bram falls and the captain groans
Bram says go without him; Bee hauls him up and refuses
The captain wakes and insists on crawling himself
Bee and Bram follow the stubborn old man toward the roots

s01110.summary: Cornelius sits in his car as an answering machine picks up
Cornelius begins a message to estranged Mara without asking her to pick up
He tells of her mother's illness and admits lying about the flowers
He shares the uncertain prognosis and where to find them
He recalls her singing on the machine and asks her to sing
Only static answers before the machine cheerfully saves the message

s00016.summary: A stranger rides into a dry creek where an armed woman waits
He asks after Cullen Pike; she claims never to have heard of him
She crosses to face him, shotgun ready, and demands his name
Jedediah's church name draws a startled laugh and the shotgun dips
Odalys reveals Cullen was her father, buried under the second pier
Jedediah doffs his hat; Odalys levels the shotgun, blaming his employer

s01055.summary: Philomena cooks and needles Artur for missing Sundays
Philomena jokes her late husband's cooking was all lies
Artur tries to keep the day light while Philomena prods
Philomena calls out that he brought Soledad to deliver news
Artur tells his mother the doctor's results show she is sick
Philomena says she already knew from the cough
Artur says they want to place her with nurses for a while
Tearful, Philomena gathers them to sit and feeds Soledad
Philomena reveals the only secret ingredient is her Sunday devotion
Soledad eats through tears and Artur takes his mother's hand

s00003.summary: Abebe's crucial stone in the salt mine final dies short
Dez calls the game; Abebe blames himself and Inez reassures him
Foreman Gus arrives demanding they clear the lane for shift change
Inez begs for the end and Gus grants one stone
Inez steadies Abebe's shaking hands before his throw
The clean release slides long and touches nothing

pd_sisters_2.summary: Tuzenbach proposes a benefit concert praising Masha's playing
Vershinin reports the brigade may be transferred far away
Chebutikin drops and smashes the clock that belonged to their mother
Chebutikin muses nihilistically and blurts Natasha's affair before exiting
Vershinin recounts his frightened girls during the fire
As Masha enters, Vershinin philosophizes about life centuries ahead

s01096.summary: Inez leads a team along the catwalk toward a crouched figure
With four minutes to overture, Inez orders the figure to drop the case
Dorothea sends Augusto to cut the chandelier cable
Inez urges restraint and the figure turns out to be Violetta
Violetta laments being fired after four hundred nights of singing
Barnabas aims as Violetta reaches for the clasp; Inez makes him lower it
Violetta asks to sing once more and Dorothea gives her a spotlight
The briefcase spills blank sheet music; there was never a bomb
Violetta sings one clear note and everyone stands awed

s01054.summary: A woman locks herself in a motel room and checks every corner
She tests a tape recorder and logs day one
Playback adds her own voice whispering I'm in the room
The extra line vanishes on replay and she forces calm
A key tag reminds her she is Lena Marsh, rehearsing her identity
The recorder turns on alone and her voice speaks of tomorrow
Lena rips out the cassette and hurls it into the TV
The bathroom light and doorknob move on their own as she begs
Hiding under the bed, the cracked tape murmurs day two

s00018.summary: Ezekiel tells Pippa he fell off boats twice, painlessly the second time
Junior wants off and Ezekiel calls them simply committed

s01033.summary: In a stalled funicular, Silas accuses August of pulling the brake
August warns Silas off his pocket and hints at their employer
Scrapes sound on the roof and the car sways
Zofia drops through the hatch with an ice axe and demands the briefcase
Silas opens the case to reveal it empty
August says Silas knows and points to a handprint outside the glass
The car drops ten feet and catches as all three scream
